title: 🤬 Arrest Made in Animal Abuse Case in Talesh, Iran
text:
🤬 Arrest Made in Animal Abuse Case in Talesh, Iran"

""
"Iran's Law Enforcement Police have arrested the driver of a vehicle in the northern city of Talesh after a shocking video went viral on social media. The footage showed the driver dragging a dog behind the car. Officials confirmed that the suspect has been handed over to the judicial authorities to face legal proceedings.
